summary: Invesco Real Estate Income Trust Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to report routine monthly distributions on its common stock. On April 30, 2026, the Board declared gross distributions of $0.1380 per share across all classes (T, S, D, I, E, N, S-PR, K-PR), with net distributions ranging from $0.1198 to $0.1380 after servicing fees. The distributions are payable to holders of record on April 30, 2026, to be paid on or about May 11, 2026, in cash or reinvested under the DRIP plan. No special-situation event—such as a merger, tender, restructuring, or activist campaign—is disclosed. This is an ordinary periodic distribution announcement, not a special situation.
